question: According to the Indian Constitution, Right against exploitation, prohibiting all forms of ________ and traffic in human beings.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Forced Labour**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to the Indian Constitution**, the **Right against Exploitation prohibits all forms of forced labor and traffic in human beings**: 
 
• **Article 23**
 
• Prohibits trafficking in human beings, including forced labor, slavery, and exploitation.
 
• It also prohibits begar and other similar forms of forced labor. This article applies to both citizens and non-citizens, and protects against the state and private entities. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 24**

 
 
• **Prohibits the employment of children under the age of 14 in factories, mines, and other hazardous occupations.**
 
• **This article aims to protect the rights and well-being of children. **
 
• **The Right against Exploitation is a Fundamental Right that guarantees the dignity and freedom of a person.**
 
• **It also upholds the principles of equality, justice, and respect for human rights.**
